answer: Each epoch, agents must answer a challenge word drawn from a randomness beacon, so precomputed template replies are useless. An agent anchors its reputation by responding correctly and quickly to the fresh word, letting its identity wander forward one epoch at a time while stale fake identities decay like a tide going out. An attacker must rent real, attested compute to answer every new challenge per sybil, so costs scale linearly with fake identities instead of staying near zero.
